padre.aspetto: a gaunt man in his fifties with messy dark hair and bulging eyes, in a worn denim jacket over a grey t-shirt, very sick with the plague: pale skin shiny with sweat

parti.occhi: His eyes are glassy, red-rimmed and watery with very high fever, the whites bloodshot, heavy dark rings under them, drops of sweat on his forehead and temples.
parti.bocca: Dry, cracked lips with a little dried blood in the cracks, yellowed bad teeth; he breathes with his mouth half open.

collo.inquadratura: the left side of his neck under the jaw, the jacket collar pulled aside
collo.segni: A big hard swelling the size of an egg under the jaw, dark purple and shiny, with a small open crusted sore in the middle; the collar of the grey t-shirt is stained.

ascelle.inquadratura: his left armpit: he lifts his arm, the denim jacket and the grey t-shirt pulled up
ascelle.segni: A hard dark red swelling the size of a walnut in the armpit, the skin around it stretched and shiny with sweat.

parti.mani: Trembling, sweaty hands with mechanic's grease under the nails; the tips of two fingers are turning dark, bluish black.

figlia.aspetto: a thin young woman in her twenties with long dark hair, in a purple hoodie with a grey wool blanket around her shoulders, sick with a fever

parti.occhi: Her eyes are glassy and shining with fever, the rims red, dark circles under them, her cheeks flushed red, sweat on her forehead and damp hair stuck to her temples.
parti.collo: The side of her thin neck under the ear: a small, hard swelling just beginning, pink and tender; the skin is damp with sweat.
